reasoning: Tennessee is a strongly Republican state, with its statewide Cook PVI commonly listed around R+20. In the last 45 days, I found no credible general-election Senate or presidential poll specific to Tennessee; the available results were primary coverage and an election-forecast page indicating Bill Hagerty remains a heavy favorite, so the current Senate margin is best characterized as strongly Republican rather than a measured D/R polling margin.

sources.name: Pollsmax Tennessee Senate Forecast
sources.details: Forecast model rates the Tennessee Senate race as Solid R and projects Bill Hagerty ahead by 29.8 points.

sources.name: The New York Times Tennessee U.S. Senate Primary 2026
sources.details: Live primary results show Bill Hagerty won the Republican Senate primary overwhelmingly, but this is a primary result rather than a general-election margin.

sources.details: Report on an internal/leased Republican primary poll for Tennessee governor, not the Senate or presidential general election; it showed Blackburn leading by fewer than four points.
